answer: An autonomous shipping network curbs Sybil attacks through acoustic attestation at docking terminals. To register, an agent broadcasts ultrasonic pulses from a quartz resonator through an opal diffuser to a sensor on the harbor jetty. An attacker must expend scarce capital deploying dedicated acoustic hardware per persona rather than virtualizing software nodes. However, turbulent water and ambient port noise can corrupt transmissions, falsely rejecting valid agents.
